face_reason: 고리의 대칭과 신성한 긴 실루엣을 정돈된 긴 얼굴과 고요한 눈매로 해석한다.
final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): elongated face, long length, narrow width; long chin with defined jaw; almond eyes, medium size, downturned outer corners, wide-set; straight medium brows; broad low bridge nose; thin lips.
face_comparison: Elongated narrower face, long chin, straight brows, thin lips and downward almond eyes; noticeably longer facial structure than Shaymin, Phione and Manaphy. White-gold long curls distinguish her from Darkrai long asymmetric black hair.
family: Neither species has a normal evolution family; forms share the original light anchor.
